name: Infernal Tiefling

traits.name: Infernal Resistance
traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Fire Bolt
traits.description: At character level 1, know Fire Bolt and cast it at will.

traits.name: Hellish Rebuke
traits.description: At character level 3, always have Hellish Rebuke available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots. The free casting is at spell level 2, retaining the 2014 Infernal Legacy benefit.

traits.name: Darkness
traits.description: At character level 5, always have Darkness available. Cast it once without using a spell slot per Long Rest, and also with appropriate spell slots.

reviewNotes: Inherits Fiend (Native), normal biological needs, Low-Light Vision and Thaumaturgy from species.tiefling.
Choose Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma when selecting this ancestry. The choice governs all granted Tiefling spells, including Thaumaturgy.
Level 3 and level 5 spells have independent once-per-Long-Rest free castings; appropriate spell slots can be used additionally.
The level 3 free Hellish Rebuke uses a second-level casting, preserving the selected 2014 Infernal Legacy exception. Spell-slot casting follows the actual slot level.
No mandatory cultural Upbringing or language; relative benefit and spell balance remain subject to playtesting.
